scope: Theorem U-MF (notes/mfU_theorem.md): the algorithm FACTOR_MF is Las Vegas. On every input N >= 2 it returns the complete prime factorization (every prime is either a sieved prime or AKS-certified). Its expected running time is at most L_N[2/5, c_MF + o(1)], where c_MF depends on parameters and on a constant C_gamma that comes from the implied constants of the cited theorems, so no single numeric constant is stated (the README gives about 9.45 at C_gamma = 0). On this board that is 2^{b^{2/5+o(1)}}, theta 2/5. The row states no constant c.
